ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the above food web diagram, which species is the tertiary consumer?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web, the arrows of Grass point respectively to Cricket, Sheep, and Deer; the arrow of Cricket points to Rat; the arrow of Rat points to Owl, and there is also a downward arrow pointing to Wolf; Sheep and Deer also have arrows pointing to Wolf. Reasoning: The arrows indicate that energy flows from the organism being eaten to the predator. Along the chain Grass → Cricket → Rat → Owl, Grass is the producer, Cricket is the primary consumer, Rat is the secondary consumer, and Owl eats Rat, so Owl is the tertiary consumer.
